create_random_forest_config: create a RandomForestConfig with custom n_estimators and splitting criterion
build_random_forest_agent: build a random forest agent using make_agent factory with RandomForestConfig
run_random_forest_agent: run the random forest agent on training data and prior knowledge to get an epistemic sampler
test_enn_sampler: test the enn_sampler returned by the agent with input arrays to get log-probability logits
review_random_forest_config: review the RandomForestConfig dataclass with n_estimators and criterion fields
